content.title: Patrick Muldoon Family: Was the 'Starship Troopers' and 'Melrose Place' actor, who died at age 57, married?
content.text: Actualizado 20/04/2026 - 05:10 CDTThe sudden death of Patrick Muldoon has prompted an outpouring of tributes for a familiar face of 1990s television and film, but it has also sparked curiosity about the personal life he chose to keep mostly private. To watch this video, agree to share video information with third partiesAgree|More infoKnown for his roles in Melrose Place, Days of Our Lives and Starship Troopers, Muldoon died on April 19 at the age of 57 following a reported heart attack, according to Deadline.As fans reflect on his decades-long career, many have been asking a simple question: was he married?The answer underscores just how guarded Muldoon was away from the screen. He was not married at the time of his death, though he had been in a committed relationship with producer Miriam Rothbart since 2023. The actor rarely spoke publicly about his romantic life, offering only occasional glimpses through social media and interviews.Muldoon confirmed his relationship in a characteristically understated way. In an October 2025 appearance on the MisSPELLING podcast, he addressed speculation about his personal life directly, saying, "I have a girlfriend for the past two years."He also shared a more lighthearted moment months earlier on social media, marking an anniversary with Rothbart. "My girl. 2 years 2gether today from the night this picture was taken where I got you drunk enough to become my girlfriend. Thank u," he wrote alongside a photo of the pair.Rothbart, who transitioned from a career in entertainment law into film and music production, founded Rothbart Productions in 2018 and has remained active in the Los Angeles arts scene. Her work has included executive producing projects such as Only Child, while also serving in leadership roles with institutions like the Institute of Contemporary Art Los Angeles.A life anchored by familyWhile Muldoon kept romantic relationships largely out of public view, he was more open when it came to family. Born to Deanna Muldoon and Patrick Muldoon Sr., he maintained a close bond with his sister, Shana Zappa, often expressing that connection through social media.In one post celebrating her birthday, he wrote, "Like i said I love and adore you and thankful every day your my sister. Happy Birthday," offering a rare, personal insight into his life beyond acting.Friends and relatives have described a family-oriented side to the actor, with gatherings and shared moments forming a steady presence away from Hollywood's spotlight.Clearing up misinformation after his passingIn the aftermath of Muldoon's death, inaccurate claims about his personal life have circulated online, including suggestions that he had been married for many years. There is no verified evidence to support those reports.Instead, the picture that emerges is one of a man who maintained a clear boundary between his professional identity and his private world. His relationship with Rothbart, though relatively recent, offered a rare window into that side of his life without ever fully stepping into public view.For many, that balance between visibility and privacy is part of what defined Muldoon's legacy. He was a recognizable figure on screen, yet remained, by choice, something of an enigma off it.As tributes continue to highlight his work, those closest to him are remembering not just the roles he played, but the quieter life he built beyond them.
